title: Greedy Volume Maximization of Gradient Embeddings for Long-Tailed Frame-Level Bioacoustic Active Learning
abstract: arXiv:2607.13555v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Bioacoustic call-type classification relies on costly expert annotation. Active learning can reduce this burden by selecting a small batch of segments for expert annotation and using the labeled segments for training the classifier. The setting is hard: the target calls are extremely sparse and the call-type distribution is long-tailed, so a tight budget must be spent on the few rare, informative segments. We propose BADGE-Greedy-DPP, a deterministic batch selector that greedily adds the segment whose BADGE gradient embedding most enlarges the volume spanned by the batch; because this log-volume objective is submodular, the greedy rule guarantees a batch value at least a (1-1/e) fraction of the optimum of this objective, a guarantee not provided by BADGE's existing k-means++ and MCMC DPP sampling heuristics. translated_title: 面向长尾帧级生物声学主动学习的梯度嵌入贪心体积最大化
translated_abstract: 生物声学鸣声类型分类依赖于昂贵的专家标注。主动学习可以通过选择一小批片段供专家标注，并利用这些已标注片段训练分类器，从而减轻这一负担。该任务场景十分困难：目标鸣声极为稀疏，且鸣声类型分布呈长尾状，因此必须将有限的预算花费在少数稀有且信息量大的片段上。我们提出 BADGE-Greedy-DPP，一种确定性的批次选择器，它贪心地加入能使批次所张成体积获得最大增幅的 BADGE 梯度嵌入对应的片段；由于该对数体积目标是次模的，贪心规则可保证批次价值至少达到该目标最优值的 (1-1/e) 比例，这是 BADGE 现有的 k-means++ 与 MCMC DPP 采样启发式方法所不具备的保证。该任务还存在时间粒度不匹配的问题：采集函数对整个片段进行打分，然而信息……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出 BADGE-Greedy-DPP，通过贪心最大化批次梯度嵌入所张成的体积来选择标注批次，具有 (1-1/e) 的次模近似保证，适用于目标稀疏、长尾分布的帧级生物声学鸣声分类主动学习。
en_tdlr: BADGE-Greedy-DPP is a deterministic active learning batch selector that greedily maximizes the volume spanned by batch gradient embeddings, achieving a (1-1/e) submodular approximation guarantee for sparse, long-tailed frame-level bioacoustic call-type annotation.
